mcat_description.short: Prefabricated sheds are factory-manufactured steel structures — primarily Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — assembled on-site for industrial, warehouse, factory, and commercial use. They are sold as supply-only or turnkey (design, fabrication, and erection) solutions, with structural components made from mild steel or high-tensile steel and roofing/cladding in colour-coated metal sheets or insulated panels.
mcat_description.long: A prefabricated shed is a steel-framed building system where primary structural members (columns, rafters, built-up I-sections), secondary members (Z/C purlins, wall girts, eave struts), and cover sheeting (colour-coated metal roofing, insulated sandwich panels) are fabricated off-site and bolted together on-site, enabling construction timelines significantly faster than conventional RCC structures. In the Indian market, the dominant commercial form is the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) shed, designed using CAD/BIM software and manufactured to IS 2062 E250 grade steel specifications, with structures compliant with IS/BIS standards for structural steel detailing and load calculations. Buyers typically specify span (10 m to 100 m+), height (20 ft to 40 ft), bay length, insulation type (rock wool, glass wool, PUF panels), and surface finish (epoxy zinc-rich primer, synthetic enamel, or PU topcoat). The category also includes smaller agricultural sheds, poultry/goat farm sheds, terrace roofing sheds, and marriage hall sheds, all sharing the same prefabricated steel assembly principle.

sub_segment_units.note: Fixed-size small sheds (e.g. goat farm, poultry shed) may be quoted per unit/piece when dimensions are standardised.
Large turnkey contracts (design + fabrication + erection) are often quoted as a total project cost, though per-sq-ft benchmarking is still used for comparison.
When only the steel structural components are supplied (without erection), some sellers quote per kg of steel fabricated.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Prefabricated Shed' is commercially synonymous with 'PEB Shed' (Pre-Engineered Building shed) — a factory-fabricated steel structure assembled on-site using bolted connections, with primary framing of built-up I-section steel members and secondary framing of Z/C purlins and wall girts. Multiple manufacturer sources confirm that structural steel used is IS 2062 E250 grade, and structures are designed and erected in compliance with IS/BIS standards for structural steel detailing and load calculations; BIS IS 15917 (2010) governs building design and erection using prefabricated components. The PEB market in India is reported to be growing at a CAGR of approximately 11.5% between 2025–2030, driven by industrialisation and logistics expansion (single source — Jai Bharat PEB, citing CII). Key differentiators buyers compare include span width (10 m to 100 m+), eave height, insulation type (rock wool, glass wool, PUF sandwich panels), roofing sheet profile, and surface coating (epoxy zinc-rich primer + synthetic enamel/PU topcoat). The category spans industrial/warehouse PEB sheds (dominant segment), agricultural sheds (poultry, goat farm), terrace roofing sheds, and marriage hall sheds — all sharing the same prefabricated steel assembly principle. Sellers typically offer supply-only, supply-and-erect, or full turnkey (design + fabrication + erection) service models. Leading Indian manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Kirby Building Systems, Interarch, Zamil Steel, and Tata BlueScope Steel.
